summary: Enhance your skills in stakeholder engagement and donor mapping with our comprehensive training. Join us to drive impactful relationships and funding success.
lede: Stakeholder engagement and donor mapping help project, program, fundraising, and partnership professionals plan relationships that support initiatives. The training covers identifying stakeholders, mapping their power and interests, and creating engagement plans to manage expectations and resistance. Participants also learn to scan donor priorities, prioritize prospects, and align a program’s value proposition with funding interests.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across sectors who need to build and maintain strong stakeholder and donor relationships to ensure project success.
audience: Community engagement officers and social safeguards teams
Corporate affairs, CSR, and sustainability managers
modules: Power, Interest, Influence and Decision Dynamics
Stakeholder Risk, Resistance, and Conflict Triggers
Value Proposition and Positioning for Funding Readiness
Negotiation and Influence Skills for Multi-Actor Environments
Monitoring Engagement and Improving Over Time
prerequisites: Participants should have basic project management experience and familiarity with stakeholder interaction.
